BroTown navigation · V4

Core flows plus town services, crafting and shops, redesigned from the player’s point of view. Not production art. The dashboard is fixed at 243 points (52 header + 191 body) at the 390 × 844 reference size.

Try these paths:

  1. Skills → Mining → see current and next yield.
  2. Achievements → First Blood → wear title; filter to earned.
  3. Bro → Pets → Catch a pet; try the sample owned-pet state below.
  4. Rankings → choose a fish record or skill board.
  5. Monsters → Snowman → Drops / Info / Where.
  6. Social → Friends / Party; Skills → Skill guilds.

Prototype only: sample data, local simulations, and clearly marked links to existing windows. The actual game is not connected.

Test both pet states using these prototype-only controls.
